entries.title: Neural Archon / full eye-width thermal beams
entries.note: Fresh actual native Furious4510HP brain checkpoint; other life bars cleared before capture. Invulnerable input-only observer alternates safe eye-laser flanks, then defeats the copy with normal weapon inputs. No recorder HP/phase/clock writes. Beams launch at32px from exact current pupils, reach full length outward in0.16s, expand to42px and keep a continuous white-hot core with eye-matched red/orange/yellow energy. Pose-specific emitting lenses stay visible over hit flashes. Authored warning, damage and recovery agree. Geysers/cloud shield and native death remain. No-GOD beam escapes separately tested on Normal/Hard/Furious.
